verdict.reasons: Correct single white-and-blue cylindrical AFP drip-tape carton roll is shown with an authentic, readable main AFP mark and blue water-drop symbol. The installed thin black tape/wet-soil strip matches the requested continuous drip-tape monitoring evidence, with strong contrast against lighter dry soil and neutral seedlings. The required watermark is present. No people, wrong commercial roll, collage, split panel, impossible geometry, or substituted hardware is present. The package-soil gap and general framing are acceptable; minor framing or soil-shape details are advisory only.

focused_physical_review.reason: The white-and-blue AFP package is positioned on a raised soil bed that lacks a broad, uninterrupted soil gap around its complete footprint, particularly where the adjacent field furrow approaches from the right. The irrigation lateral line visible in the frame is physically separated from the package and does not touch or cross its base. No distinct additional loose coils are present outside the required package, and the sides and base of the carton are clean with no protruding tape, ribbon, or strap tails visible.

acceptance_warnings: Independent physical condition not met: clear_soil_gap

acceptance_decision.source: user requested practical >=90 acceptance; actual saved vision evidence retained
